name: Hybrid Volume Rendering
definition: A rendering method that simultaneously traces rays through volumetric sample arrays and polygonal databases, resampling both at equally spaced intervals, and compositing the resulting colors and opacities in depth-sorted order to handle mixtures of geometric and volumetric data.
summary: Hybrid Volume Rendering mixes geometric and volumetric data by casting rays through both, compositing them in depth-sorted order to handle scenes with polygonal models and volumetric data in a single pass.
